elements.char: sampling patterns [2]. In the method of [23], a set of candidate
elements.label: text

elements.char: masks is considered and a sampling pattern is selected by
elements.label: text

elements.char: adding candidate masks one at a time according to a greedy
elements.label: text

elements.char: selection rule: at each stage, the candidate is chosen among
elements.label: text

elements.char: the remaining candidates that gives the maximum increase
elements.label: text

elements.char: of a performance measure on a training set. A drawback of
elements.label: text

elements.char: the method from [23] is that the lower level regularisation
elements.label: text

elements.char: parameter, has to be fixed beforehand; we fix the regular-
elements.label: text

elements.char: isation parameter learned with our method on the training
elements.label: text

elements.char: set, apply the method from [23] to learn a line pattern, and
elements.label: text

elements.char: finally tune the regularisation parameter on the training set
elements.label: text

elements.char: with our method to improve the performance of the pattern
elements.label: text

elements.char: learned with with the method from [23]. The uninformed
elements.label: text

elements.char: variable density sampling pattern from [2] does not fix the
elements.label: text

elements.char: reconstruction method, so we use our method to learn the
elements.label: text

elements.char: optimal regularisation parameter on the training set for this
elements.label: text

elements.label: text

elements.label: text

elements.char: method effectively requires (less than) two lower level solves.
